label: Founders Pledge's 2023 education method (income from learning)

rows.label: Annual salary increase per standard deviation of learning (2023 education method)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023)

rows.explainer: How much more a person earns each year, as a share of earnings, for each standard deviation their test scores rose at school: Founders Pledge's average across five lines of evidence in its 2023 education report (Education: Evidence and Recommendations). Its education recommendations since 2023 (Imagine Worldwide, Teaching at the Right Level Africa, EIDU, Ubongo, Central Square Foundation) rest on this method.

rows.label: Replicability adjustment on education's income evidence (2023 education method)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023)

rows.explainer: How much of the earnings gain above Founders Pledge expects to hold up: the average of two ways of comparing the education evidence with the evidence for deworming's long-run income effect. Founders Pledge's own judgment.

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023)

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's wait between a primary-school program and the start of higher earnings, chosen for consistency with its deworming analysis.

rows.label: Working years the income gain from learning lasts (2023 education method)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023)

rows.explainer: How long Founders Pledge counts the higher earnings: a working life of 40 years, chosen for consistency with its deworming analysis.

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023)

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge counts the earner's gain twice over because it is shared with the household, as in its deworming analysis.

rows.label: Prior for an education program's learning gain (2023 education method)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide Malawi CEA (2023)
source.quote: our general recommendation would be only a 25% weight on the prior of 0.1 given the adjusted sample size >2000

rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's 2023 education method averages a measured learning gain with a prior of 0.1 standard deviations (Education: Evidence and Recommendations, section III.A): 25% weight on the prior when the evidence is large (an adjusted sample over 2,000), more when it is weaker or the program is a scale-up.
